before: Body.insertParagraph at Start or End wrote the paragraph into the first or last cell of a table that opened or closed the body.
after: The paragraph is a sibling of that table, before or after it. Under tracking, its paragraph mark and text carry w:ins markers.
reason: The edit writes an ordinary paragraph beside a table, the same nodes an untracked or tracked paragraph insertion already writes elsewhere. Released participants read and merge these nodes with their current rules, so shared data keeps its meaning.
